e052bce0-9e58-4b89-af9a-676255e709ad/Eve.en: Watching the disciples turn on each other, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> trembles with fear, his legs shaking,<NL>still, he stifles the fear in his heart and insists,<NL><NL>"This person wasn't like this before. There must be a reason for <Character key=RanshanFootman str=GenderPossessive/> fall to Deviation!<NL>Successor of Taiwu, let us search elsewhere—surely we can uncover the reason behind this!"

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Eve.en: But in a world of countless contests and victories, why is it only the Tri-School Contest on Ranshan repeatedly leads to Deviation?<NL>Is this contest truly worth the disciples discarding their bonds and the teachings of the sages, fighting with deadly force?<NL>At a loss, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly sees several Ranshan disciples rushing over on clouds,<NL>their eyes fierce, their brows clouded with malice,<NL><NL>"There! That's him!"<NL>"The martial arts he used differ from those of Ranshan!"<NL>"He's not one of our disciples! Speak! Were you using an immortal technique!?"

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.en: The techniques I use are well-known martial arts, passed down through the ages. How could they be called immortal techniques?
0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.ru: Техники, которые я использую, являются хорошо известными Боевыми искусствами, передаваемыми из поколения в поколение. Как их можно было назвать Бессмертными техниками?

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.en: Immortality is what Ranshan seeks. I'm no villain—why would I take what they desire?
0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.ru: Бессмертие - это то, к чему стремится Жаньшань. Я не злодей — зачем мне брать то, чего они желают?

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.en: Since I'm not participating in the Tri-School Contest, with neither victory nor defeat, why would I covet immortal techniques?
0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.ru: Поскольку я не участвую в Конкурсе Трех школ, не одержав ни победы, ни поражения, с чего бы мне желать Бессмертных техник?

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.en: I am an immortal of the clouds. Since you've seen me, why don't you bow?
0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.ru: Я - Бессмертный из облаков. Раз уж ты меня увидел, почему бы тебе не поклониться?

0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.en: If the Successor of Taiwu can learn Ranshan's martial arts, what's wrong with learning immortal techniques?
0bd3a7bd-5e4c-4ca2-b775-7c9428e8dccf/Opt.ru: Если Преемник Тайу может научиться Боевым искусствам Жаньшаня, что плохого в изучении Бессмертных техник?

f1cd2483-d4d7-4130-b397-e76830acca2d/Eve.en: Originally, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> had been running around dealing with the deviated disciples, only revealing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> skills when necessary.<NL>Unexpectedly, the disciples not only showed no gratitude but also turned on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>, completely ignoring <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s words,<NL><NL>"Don't try to fool us. The martial arts you're using are so similar to those three disciples!"<NL>"This person has been befriending Ranshan disciples—could <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> be using them to seek immortal techniques?"<NL>"In my opinion, this person must have already found the immortal techniques and taught them to those disciples!"<NL><NL>With that, the disciples exchange glances,<NL>their eyes turning fierce as they reach for their weapons and close in on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...

f1cd2483-d4d7-4130-b397-e76830acca2d/Opt.en: (These disciples might not listen to reason now...)
f1cd2483-d4d7-4130-b397-e76830acca2d/Opt.ru: (Эти ученики, возможно, сейчас не прислушиваются к голосу разума...)

88dd6633-2470-438f-850a-402bee283df9/Eve.en: In an instant, their inner malice surfaces...<NL>their faces turn pale, eyes hollow and fixated on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>Then, drawing their blades and radiating the eerie madness of the Bewitched, they charge at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> in a frenzy,<NL><NL>"The immortal techniques... hand them over!"

8e022629-ba96-4cac-8eb2-ae24cc695b82/Eve.en: Flying swords, seals, and finger strikes come at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> from all directions.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> wields the Fuyu Hilt, weaving through the chaos, knocking down the disciples one by one,<NL>but the mist wrapped around the Fuyu Hilt grows thicker, enveloping it layer by layer.<NL><NL>Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> can figure out what's happening,<NL>another deviated disciple, with a fierce aura, charges at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> with a sharp blade.

8a6c6dcf-97e5-4836-a842-4bbe8476b726/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> steels <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self, steps forward,<NL>and skillfully delivers three precise thrusts to the disciple's forehead, each varying in speed, force, and direction.<NL>The disciple, already no match for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, stumbles back and collapses.<NL><NL>But just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> relaxes slightly and turns to deal with the other disciples...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> catches a glimpse of the fallen disciple already rising to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> feet,<NL>gripping <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> blade tightly, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> expression still ferocious, the eerie aura around <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> undiminished.

7f7cde99-3b3e-434d-9763-f90f83021055/Eve.en: Seeing the disciple swing their blade in a horizontal slash,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pivots, sinking into a defensive stance, and raises the Fuyu Hilt to block the incoming strike. But <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> notices something odd about the hilt,<NL>the characters "Fuyu" engraved on it have become blurred...<NL>Meanwhile, the surrounding disciples close in, weapons drawn, taking advantage of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s moment of distraction.

7f7cde99-3b3e-434d-9763-f90f83021055/Opt.en: (The situation is dire... What should I do?)

3c44ace8-8dfe-498e-af06-8b7b54cebb6e/Eve.en: The Fuyu Hilt has lost its power, and it's now a fight against overwhelming odds...<NL>At this moment, countless familiar faces flash through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind. After years of wandering and training, surely some martial arts can turn the tide.<NL>Just as the thought takes shape, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> hears a shout from above,<NL><NL>"Seniors—I'm counting on you!"<NL><NL>With that cry, three figures descend from the sky one after another, blocking the deviated disciples nearby.

3c44ace8-8dfe-498e-af06-8b7b54cebb6e/Opt.en: Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, Ying Jiao...
3c44ace8-8dfe-498e-af06-8b7b54cebb6e/Opt.ru: Хуа Чжу, Сюань Чжи, Ин Цзяо...

003801b3-9c3f-409e-9dc8-ddc34c1e2132/Eve.en: Hua Ju's massive figure slams down behind...<NL>He spreads his large, fan-like hands, and the seals in his grasp transform into a dozen golden charms, each towering a zhang high.<NL><NL>"Divine Thunder Techniques, Manifest the Revered!"<NL><NL>With a low roar from Hua Ju, the charms are enveloped in layers of white clouds, forming an inescapable Omnisnare...<NL>Trapping all the deviated disciples behind in a prison of cloud-bound seals.

e39f185f-0e37-421e-ab11-9e5a120a8b6d/Eve.en: Then Hua Ju pulls out a binding spell and slaps it onto the deviated disciple in front of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>lifting him easily and tossing him behind, then paying no further heed to the others.<NL>He simply stares at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> in silence, his expression grave.

64c64846-10d8-4c3e-8112-d8f992c7e978/Eve.en: Xuan Zhi draws the sword from his back and hurls it into the sea of clouds below.<NL>Then, with a hand seal, countless purple lights surge forth, tearing through the clouds and shooting upward.<NL><NL>"Sword beyond the dust, merge into the three thousand!"<NL><NL>At Xuan Zhi's command, the purple lights dive like eagles swooping on prey, targeting the deviated disciples on the right.

1eabe65e-e261-4fc8-8aa5-62e21a1638b7/Eve.en: A streak of green light drifts down from above, clashing with a few disciples near <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>while Xuan Zhi, still drowsy, strolls casually to stand before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>He reeks of alcohol, his gaze fixed on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, yet he remains silent.

59952462-863a-4bad-b1bd-e470e726f00b/Eve.en: Ying Jiao lands gracefully to the right of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL>With a casual flick of her finger, she seals the vital points of a nearby disciple.<NL>Then she turns to gaze at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, her eyes deep and inscrutable.

d180d0f9-1b6b-4dfc-be43-25335490927f/Eve.en: Ying Jiao's elegant figure descends lightly.<NL>She raises her right finger, and wisps of spiritual Qi follow her arm's motion, emerging from the sea of clouds.<NL><NL>"Qi Conservation, stand unwavering!"<NL><NL>She thrusts forward, and her force crashes like waves through the clouds,<NL>driving the deviated disciples on the left back over ten chis.

2671c6b1-6721-4bb8-b1ee-edb336bdacd5/Eve.en: The three unleash their powers, carving out a moment of calm amidst the encirclement...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks at the trio, feeling they are no longer the same youths who once came seeking guidance.<NL>Then, they speak,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, Hua Ju is here to assist!"<NL>"We finally made it. Though the clouds are free and easy, it's like looking at flowers through fog—only Taiwu knows what's really happening!"<NL>"Master is an honored guest of Ranshan. For them to behave like this—they're definitely getting punished when they return!"

28f36d3f-1859-4112-b6a1-14587f184965/Eve.en: Hearing their words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> faintly recalls the times they spent together in the past.<NL>Seeing the resolve return to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes, Hua Ju steps forward and asks,<NL><NL>"Chaos disrupts the Tri-School Contest—Successor of Taiwu, what should we do now?"

28f36d3f-1859-4112-b6a1-14587f184965/Opt.en: The top priority is to uncover what caused the disciples' fall to Deviation...
28f36d3f-1859-4112-b6a1-14587f184965/Opt.ru: Главный приоритет - раскрыть, что стало причиной падения учеников до Искажения...

4eace8af-dd67-4882-b673-ef787f739ae0/Eve.en: Hua Ju frowns and considers,<NL><NL>"You're right. With the disciples like this, even if there's a winner...<NL>it's impossible to judge their cultivation or virtue fairly. This so-called duel means little now.<NL>This place is filled with disputes and grievances, making it hard to uncover the truth...<NL>I know a place where the cause of the disciples' Deviation might lie."

4eace8af-dd67-4882-b673-ef787f739ae0/Opt.en: (The layers of white clouds here, the endless disputes among the disciples, indeed make it hard to uncover the truth...)
4eace8af-dd67-4882-b673-ef787f739ae0/Opt.ru: (Слои белых облаков здесь, бесконечные споры между учениками действительно затрудняют раскрытие истины...)

d8e2115f-3caf-4c13-ae7d-282f484dba06/Eve.en: As they ponder, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> quietly descends from the clouds and urgently says,<NL><NL>"I recognize seven or eight of them,<NL>normally, they'd never raise a blade against each other! If we don't figure out what's going on soon, I fear they'll... they'll...<NL>Successor of Taiwu, seniors, I beg you!"

93814dfa-3b5e-4ff9-b818-ad9d93533fbb/Eve.en: Hua Ju gestures in a direction, inviting <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> to go first...<NL>while he, Xuan Zhi, Ying Jiao, and <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> follow close behind, just like the old days,<NL>as if master and three devoted students.

1d68c42a-f36c-475e-8b54-e1d82d47255f/Eve.en: The five of them ride the clouds, traveling for an unknown amount of time...<NL>As the clouds continuously retreat, it feels as though a day in the sky is a decade on earth, with the seasons cycling and the mountains and rivers aging.<NL>Yet, the scenes of fierce battles and drawn swords remain unchanged,<NL>like the endless path of immortality, journeying day and night, yet never reaching the end.

6cfc7028-a972-4062-b80b-426153277092/Eve.en: Amidst the tangled thoughts, Hua Ju extends a hand, gesturing downward...<NL>The five of them descend swiftly, landing gently on the ground.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> also notices that the Taiji Basin is nowhere to be seen...<NL>In its place stretches a wasteland of yellow sand, endless desert,<NL>where immortality and vitality no longer dwell.<NL><NL>As Hua Ju said, the answer to the disciples' deviation may lie near.

455b0bb2-779a-482b-a3ff-1839c26533be/Eve.en: Miles of desert spread endlessly...<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and the others make their way through the vast dunes.<NL>Sand rises over sand, ridges stretch for miles—there's no way to tell direction or distance.<NL>Suddenly, a figure stumbles into view on a slope ahead, swaying like a candle in the wind.

3e2b9cd8-7971-45e0-8cba-de199fc3643e/Eve.en: Drawing near, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees an elderly Ranshan man, hair and beard pure white, clothes in tatters.<NL>His eyes are dull and lifeless, his face etched with confusion and pain, as if he's walked this desert for centuries.<NL>But upon seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and the others, his sorrow lifts. His face brightens with joy,<NL>as he rushes forward, bowing deeply to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, and cries out,<NL><NL>"Immortal elder! Little immortals! I've finally found you!"

a558434e-1242-46cc-97e1-fe396a27e679/Eve.en: Hearing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s words, the old man's expression grows even more painful. Two tears squeeze from the cracks of his dry eyes as he trembles and says,<NL><NL>"Immortal elder... Please, don't mock me...<NL>Just look at your steady steps, and the noble bearing of that young immortal behind you. If you're not immortals... then where are they?<NL>Could it be that there are no immortals in this world? No, you must be lying to me. Everyone is lying to me!"<NL><NL>As he speaks, the old man grows increasingly agitated, his aura radiating the madness of a Bewitched.

45628af6-be98-4100-b8e1-01380c4ec6da/Eve.en: At that moment, another disciple descends from the clouds, exclaiming in shock,<NL><NL>"Qinglang Master speaks true. This Tri-School Contest truly strays far from tradition...<NL>At this point, victory and cultivation no longer matter.<NL>Successor of Taiwu, this one shows clear signs of Deviation. Let me help you bring him down!"

15b6dd16-8be2-4089-bb84-e67f0605649b/Eve.en: After a fierce struggle, the possessed disciple is sealed with seals and finally collapses to the ground.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and asks,<NL><NL>"I don't know why... but I find these seniors truly pitiful...<NL>They chase the immortal path in vain. Will I end up like them someday?"

28c0ca8c-6e3f-4a79-907a-35d1a75949a1/Eve.en: After hundreds of exchanges, the madness in the disciple's eyes grows only stronger. Finally, Hua Ju and Xuan Zhi step forward and shout,<NL><NL>"Hmph, no need to trouble the Successor of Taiwu... Xuan Zhi, let's go!"<NL>"Got it!"

612ba026-525a-4839-a7e9-a9d074f3f72d/Eve.en: Ying Jiao, standing nearby, suddenly feels moved and responds,<NL><NL>"They appear to seek immortality, but in truth, they chase their desires.<NL>Soaring to the heavens, immortality, mastering all things—this path may look glorious...<NL>But such thoughts are just endless mortal cravings, unfocused and hollow.<NL>Better to first walk among mortals and understand love and longing.<NL>Only then can one cast off desire and step onto the Tao."

224a054e-7d05-47f5-ba45-8408fdeec24b/Eve.en: Ying Jiao, standing nearby, suddenly feels moved and responds,<NL><NL>"Seeking immortality is but one of countless desires.<NL>If you desire something, you must strive to attain it, or else you can only blame your own inadequacy.<NL>Without ability, then of course you earn no pity."

fd5fe2ab-6b3d-4b2d-b59b-760093ff748b/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> looks as if realization dawns, and says with spirit,<NL><NL>"Oh! So that's it. Seeking immortality is not the same as chasing desires...<NL>I bet many people on Ranshan don't understand this. Senior Ying Jiao, how did you figure it out?"

c1e0640d-fc76-4805-a031-fbec37ddb384/Eve.en: "Figure it out? Not quite.<NL>Master taught me all of this personally—you couldn't copy me even if you tried!<NL>Anyway, there's still a long way ahead. Let's move on!"
c1e0640d-fc76-4805-a031-fbec37ddb384/Eve.ru: - Разобраться в этом? Не совсем.<NL>Мастер научил меня всему этому лично — вы не смогли бы скопировать меня, даже если бы попытались!<NL>В любом случае, впереди еще долгий путь. Давайте двигаться дальше!"

be3fb101-62d5-4504-aa81-bfeaaed4ae01/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> frowns slightly and says,<NL><NL>"Even so...<NL>I still need more time to fully grasp it.<NL>Let's keep moving for now..."
be3fb101-62d5-4504-aa81-bfeaaed4ae01/Eve.ru: Услышав это, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> слегка хмурится и говорит,<NL><NL>- Даже если и так...<NL>Мне все еще нужно больше времени, чтобы полностью осознать это.<NL>Давай пока продолжим двигаться..."

17c5cec0-4cd1-459a-92f1-988cba620baa/Eve.en: After another hundred moves, the deviated disciple is finally forced into the seal formation by flying swords, unable to move.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and asks,<NL><NL>"I don't know why... but I find these seniors truly pitiful...<NL>They chase the immortal path in vain. Will I end up like them someday?"

7b1a7141-737c-4e45-a82a-3c99168478e7/Eve.en: A sudden gust of wind stirs up sand and dust, obscuring their vision...<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and the others squint through it, they spot fragments of a Taiji basin scattered across the yellow dunes.<NL>The wild grass is withered; the broken soil reveals incomplete Taiji patterns. In the center of that broken pattern,<NL>stands a crazed Ranshan disciple, silver-haired and armed, laughing wildly toward the sky,<NL><NL>"One hundred thirty-two... One hundred thirty-two! Hahahaha!"

4da103f0-0703-4c97-8188-c7d1249b14ef/Eve.en: "One, two, three, four, five! Five of you, good!<NL>I've already won 132 matches. With you five, that'll make 137!<NL>Then I'll be the one with the most wins in the Tri-School Contest! I shall be the top of the Three Schools!"<NL><NL>Seeing the group, the old man beams, laughing loudly as if ascension is already in his grasp.<NL>Soon all of Ranshan and the mortal realm will revere him, hailing him as the Hundred-Victory Immortal.

c6c77e19-f2a4-444d-bad9-a503f96751b2/Eve.en: But in that moment, he catches a strange emotion in their eyes.<NL>Pity? Sympathy? Contempt? No one in the world should look at him like that!<NL><NL>"If you won't attack, then I'll make the first move... One hundred and thirty-three, begin!<NL>I am the top of the Three Schools... I am the top of the Three Schools..."<NL><NL>With that, he raises his weapon high, radiating the madness unique to the Bewitched.

4d6d5a4b-6c90-45c5-ac84-9370ef2ee27e/Eve.en: At that moment, another disciple descends from the clouds and declares sternly,<NL><NL>"Even with unparalleled skills, to be blinded by the pursuit of victory and harm your own sectmates—this is not the way of Ranshan!<NL>Successor of Taiwu, let me assist in subduing him."

26c3a5e6-a9f8-4824-8188-8876504b5e9f/Eve.en: After a fierce struggle, the possessed disciple is sealed with seals and finally collapses to the ground.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and sighs,<NL><NL>"One hundred thirty-two matches... Why is he so fixated?"

dbb366d8-89c3-4fa3-bcc9-09e4117c73c4/Eve.en: After hundreds of exchanges, the madness in the disciple's eyes grows only stronger. Finally, Xuan Zhi and Ying Jiao step forward and shout,<NL><NL>"Watching this makes my hands itch. Taiwu, let me have a go!"<NL>"Master, let me deal with him this time!"

5d7565c8-072a-46c2-94b8-644a1e812576/Eve.en: Hearing this, Hua Ju speaks thoughtfully,<NL><NL>"The desire for victory is like a net cast into one's heart.<NL>Obsess too much, and that net becomes a cage.<NL>But if one steps outside the net and sees it for what it is... perhaps one may find joy in the fishing itself."

517f17e4-3b71-46e5-b0b8-2d3fc16c7d61/Eve.en: Hearing this, Hua Ju adds with a cold snort,<NL><NL>"Tch, just a hundred matches. Why the fuss?<NL>Those who seek immortality should have unshakable resolve. If your will is weak, you might as well stay a mortal."

9556395b-1d71-489c-b4ee-569bac2c0342/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> looks enlightened and says,<NL><NL>"Yes! Master's poems often speak of these things too!<NL>Senior Hua Ju, you must be just as wise as Master!"
9556395b-1d71-489c-b4ee-569bac2c0342/Eve.ru: Услышав это, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> выглядит просветленным и говорит,<NL><NL>- Да! В стихах Мастера тоже часто говорится об этих вещах!<NL>Старший Хуа Чжу, вы, должно быть, так же мудры, как и учитель!"

b2c2a4bb-1f6b-47a0-b56b-f39022763caa/Eve.en: "Ahem, hardly.<NL>All this wisdom comes from the teachings of the Successor of Taiwu—a rare gift indeed.<NL>With this matter settled, we'd best not linger. Let's move."
b2c2a4bb-1f6b-47a0-b56b-f39022763caa/Eve.ru: - Кхм, вряд ли.<NL>Вся эта мудрость исходит из учений Преемника Тайу — поистине редкий дар.<NL>Теперь, когда этот вопрос решен, нам лучше не задерживаться. Давайте двигаться."

a743901d-c064-4c27-9ba8-cc32a08058e5/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> frowns slightly and says,<NL><NL>"Even so...<NL>I still need more time to fully grasp it.<NL>Let's keep moving for now..."
a743901d-c064-4c27-9ba8-cc32a08058e5/Eve.ru: Услышав это, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> слегка хмурится и говорит,<NL><NL>- Даже если и так...<NL>Мне все еще нужно больше времени, чтобы полностью осознать это.<NL>Давай пока продолжим двигаться..."

ba7f12e6-2313-40e0-8d19-02f2d30352cf/Eve.en: After another hundred moves, the deviated disciple is finally disarmed by the flying sword and Finger Arts, collapsing from exhaustion.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and asks,<NL><NL>"One hundred thirty-two matches... He clings to them so tightly..."

03a4e970-416b-4f46-91ef-5990eed40eb6/Eve.en: The vast desert stretches endlessly.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> leads the group across the wasteland. No signs of life, no sounds of insects or beasts.<NL>In the distance, crumbling towers sink half-buried in sand, their former majesty lost.<NL>Among the ruins, a disheveled, white-haired elder of Ranshan wails bitterly,<NL><NL>"Ah! I don't want to be immortal anymore—let me out!"

7dc2d453-3059-4a48-acf9-b94bc4f3d31a/Eve.en: The old man raises his hands and cries, as if trapped here for centuries.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> steps closer, he suddenly lunges, grabbing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> tightly with thin, bony hands, eyes wide,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu!<NL>All these strange happenings in the Tri-School Contest—it's your plot, isn't it? Isn't it!?<NL>Ever since you all entered the contest..."

e73e45e8-dba9-48f2-ab3e-e825103edaed/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> denies it at once, but the old man only grows angrier,<NL><NL>"Silence! Immortality should mean freedom from care!<NL>But here—there's nothing! Nothing to fear, nothing to love!<NL>Decades have passed, and all I have is this barren waste, severed from family and kin!<NL>It must be your doing—your doing!"<NL><NL>His hands clench tighter, madness of the Bewitched spilling from his body.

c7129bc9-dece-40c6-a088-0d7fee87365f/Eve.en: Just then, another disciple descends from the clouds, regret in his eyes,<NL><NL>"This man once traveled with me through the mortal world. Now... look at him.<NL>Successor of Taiwu, please—help me bring him down."

d1321c32-76e0-40da-81bc-3344d8e70da9/Eve.en: After hundreds of exchanges, the madness in the disciple's eyes grows only stronger. Finally, Hua Ju and Ying Jiao step forward and shout,<NL><NL>"Hmph, this is getting nowhere! Hua Ju, let's give Master a hand!"<NL>"Master, I'm thinking the same thing."

d01a913f-e21f-4358-b196-3ad20afbef1c/Eve.en: After a fierce struggle, the possessed disciple is sealed with seals and finally collapses to the ground.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and asks,<NL><NL>"To wander carefree beyond the mortal world... Is there really such a land of immortals out there?"

bd6d272d-2e94-454e-a84d-3875468bb280/Eve.en: Hearing this, Xian Zhi feels something stir within and chuckles,<NL><NL>"Heh, maybe there is, maybe there isn't...<NL>In this world, every rise has its fall, every joy its sorrow.<NL>What brings you joy or pain lies in your own heart.<NL>If you let go of fleeting things, don't worry over the waxing and waning moon, and savor the present—flowers, snow, breeze, and moonlight,<NL>then anywhere in the world feels like land of immortals."

e923d736-b901-4644-be7a-4296b706d7a3/Eve.en: Xian Zhi, upon hearing this, replies with a cold tone,<NL><NL>"Absolutely not...<NL>Since ancient times, countless have sought immortality just to escape worldly suffering.<NL>Birth, aging, sickness, and death... The heavens never bend to mortal will. How could a worry-free land of immortals truly exist in this world?<NL>So-called freedom is, in the end, nothing but an illusion."

c186b8e8-0365-41e9-b877-d757ed561007/Eve.en: After hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> seems enlightened and recites,<NL><NL>"Find freedom where you can, and revel in it... heh!<NL>Senior Xuan Zhi, who told you all this?"
c186b8e8-0365-41e9-b877-d757ed561007/Eve.ru: Услышав это, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> кажется просветленным и декламирует,<NL><NL>"Найди свободу там, где сможешь, и наслаждайся ею... хех!<NL>Старший Сюань Чжи, кто вам все это рассказал?"

c57278cc-7bce-4da0-a390-02d6e0f0b2c9/Eve.en: "Eh, why couldn't I have figured it out myself?<NL>Though I'll admit, much of it comes from Taiwu's teachings. Now let me pass it to you. How's that?<NL>Heh... enough boasting. Let's keep moving!"
c57278cc-7bce-4da0-a390-02d6e0f0b2c9/Eve.ru: - Эх, почему я сам не мог до этого додуматься?<NL>Хотя я признаю, что многое из этого взято из учений Тайу. А теперь позвольте мне передать это вам. Как тебе это?<NL>Хех... хватит хвастаться. Давайте продолжим двигаться!"

8b90e797-ba8a-4dca-b8d0-33e6587bc2f3/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> frowns slightly and says,<NL><NL>"Even so...<NL>I still need more time to fully grasp it.<NL>Let's keep moving for now..."
8b90e797-ba8a-4dca-b8d0-33e6587bc2f3/Eve.ru: Услышав это, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> слегка хмурится и говорит,<NL><NL>- Даже если и так...<NL>Мне все еще нужно больше времени, чтобы полностью осознать это.<NL>Давай пока продолжим двигаться..."

11bb27e6-46fb-4bd6-b946-d9b5b7d18877/Eve.en: After another hundred moves, the deviated disciple is finally disarmed by the flying sword and Finger Arts, collapsing from exhaustion.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> watches, pity flickering in his eyes, and asks,<NL><NL>"One hundred thirty-two matches... He clings to them so tightly..."

06524a9c-6a52-41ad-af96-ceb85ca98dbe/Eve.en: No cycles of the sun and moon, no distinction between heat and cold...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has walked through the desert for an unknown amount of time, with nothing but desolation and emptiness in sight.<NL>Just as the group's spirits are nearly depleted, Hua Ju's voice suddenly rings out from the other side of the dune,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu... this is the place!"

582e9090-af5b-465c-8db0-35c21ac0654c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> climbed over the hill as Hua Ju directed<NL>and saw a dozen or more Ranshan disciples, male and female, all staggering toward one direction...<NL>Their hair was disheveled, their movements uncoordinated, their forms like withered corpses, their robes tattered, murmuring incessantly,<NL><NL>"Qinglang Pavilion... Qinglang Pavilion..."<NL><NL>The whole scene gave off an eerie, indescribable feeling—resembling both a celestial procession and a malevolent mystic march.<NL>Even as a few clear-minded disciples descended from the clouds to intervene and called back their sectmates, they found themselves helpless to act.

88cd2ec5-8aca-496f-91e2-aa0d9d065715/Eve.en: Looking up,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> suddenly notices a golden glow on the horizon, toward which the disciples are heading.<NL>Upon closer inspection, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees a celestial palace hidden beneath the glow,<NL>adorned with colored glaze jade and surrounded by colorful mist and stars.<NL>Clouds swirl in colors, starlight flickers—pure opulence.

60ec849c-9760-4e0e-8295-3ec85bcbfa44/Eve.en: Such beauty ought to be awe-inspiring,<NL>but as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gazes at the palace, half-real and half-illusionary, like a mirage or a fleeting dream.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=UpperGenderSubject/> recalls the three enigmatic elders within—Xuan Huangzi, Kun Wuzi, and You Mingzi,<NL>and the tales beneath the clouds, "The upper corpse craves adornment, the middle corpse craves flavor, and the lower corpse craves desire."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> remains unmoved.

60ec849c-9760-4e0e-8295-3ec85bcbfa44/Opt.en: So, the cause of disciples falling to Deviation lies within Qinglang Pavilion?
60ec849c-9760-4e0e-8295-3ec85bcbfa44/Opt.ru: Итак, причина того, что ученики впадают в Искажение, кроется в павильоне Цинлан?

60ec849c-9760-4e0e-8295-3ec85bcbfa44/Opt.en: So many seek this place in vain—how will we make it there?
60ec849c-9760-4e0e-8295-3ec85bcbfa44/Opt.ru: Так много людей тщетно ищут это место — как мы туда доберемся?

9128184f-505b-45a8-a9ea-b4453b8b68a5/Eve.en: Hearing this, Hua Ju nods affirmatively and begins to recount Ranshan's history,<NL><NL>"To ordinary disciples, Qinglang Pavilion is a sacred place...<NL>But in truth, since the sect's founding, the Qinglang Pavilion has watched over Ranshan from the heart of the Dream of Clouds for centuries,<NL>strategizing against invasions, internal conflicts, and even the calamity of Xiangshu.<NL>It is why Ranshan has endured to this day...<NL><NL>So when it comes to Ranshan, Qinglang Pavilion knows all."

9128184f-505b-45a8-a9ea-b4453b8b68a5/Opt.en: How do you know about events from centuries ago?
9128184f-505b-45a8-a9ea-b4453b8b68a5/Opt.ru: Откуда вы знаете о событиях многовековой давности?

b9ee2ec9-f293-49b9-bfe2-29378ec52648/Eve.en: Hua Ju hesitates and falls silent.<NL>Xuan Zhi steps in to mediate,<NL><NL>"From... books, of course!<NL>Senior Hua Ju, he's always been a bit of a bookworm!"
b9ee2ec9-f293-49b9-bfe2-29378ec52648/Eve.ru: Хуа Чжу колеблется и замолкает.<NL>Сюань Чжи выступает посредником,<NL><NL>- Из... книг, конечно!<NL>Старший Хуа Чжу, он всегда был немного книжным червем!"

b9ee2ec9-f293-49b9-bfe2-29378ec52648/Opt.en: Hua Ju and a bookworm are quite different...
b9ee2ec9-f293-49b9-bfe2-29378ec52648/Opt.ru: Хуа Чжу и книжный червь - это совершенно разные вещи...

8b14390f-320a-46e7-8ee0-3dc8e9fe1937/Eve.en: Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s uncertain expression, Ying Jiao steps forward and says gently,<NL><NL>"Master, I can vouch that Hua Ju isn't lying...<NL>The Qinglang Pavilion truly holds the answer to the disciples' Deviation."

998a5a2f-466c-4cc6-abc9-25b698a8487c/Eve.en: Xuan Zhi, hearing this, grins and says,<NL><NL>"Don't worry, Taiwu!<NL>Ordinary disciples must undergo countless trials to achieve immortality,<NL>but the Immortals already see your virtue and cultivation.<NL>With so many immortals in the heavens, I think they've already reserved a spot for you!"

998a5a2f-466c-4cc6-abc9-25b698a8487c/Opt.en: How do you know about immortals?

ec196c34-ad64-4870-bfc6-9fb413dd2df6/Eve.en: Xuan Zhi stammers, unable to give a clear answer.<NL>Hua Ju steps forward and says respectfully,<NL><NL>"What Xuan Zhi says is merely our opinion...<NL>Back when we were with you day and night, we received much wisdom.<NL>If anyone is fit to guide the Tao, it's no one but the Successor of Taiwu."

6aa10ae7-c732-478e-a0dd-d416b0a93bc7/Eve.en: Ying Jiao, hearing this, also steps forward and nods in agreement,<NL><NL>"Master, if you head to Qinglang Pavilion, I'll go with you."
6aa10ae7-c732-478e-a0dd-d416b0a93bc7/Eve.ru: Ин Цзяо, услышав это, тоже делает шаг вперед и кивает в знак согласия,<NL><NL>"Учитель, если вы направитесь в павильон Цинлан, я пойду с вами".

ee64e89e-af1f-4675-9ec7-e8be48351535/Eve.en: While deep in thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> hears <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> exclaim beside <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject />.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=GenderSubject />, like the other Ranshan disciples, gazes with shining eyes, entranced,<NL><NL>"Qinglang Pavilion...<NL>Of course, the immortals know all things. We need only ask them, and the truth will be revealed!<NL>We can even ask Yu Zhuo, who became immortal at the last Tri-School Contest!"

ee64e89e-af1f-4675-9ec7-e8be48351535/Opt.en: You plan to go to Qinglang Pavilion too?
ee64e89e-af1f-4675-9ec7-e8be48351535/Opt.ru: Ты тоже планируешь пойти в павильон Цинлан?

26594c6e-05b4-4cf5-a961-38e9a704b7ff/Eve.en: "Of course I do!<NL>But not to become immortal—first, we must uncover the cause of deviation.<NL>Our sectmates are suffering. We must resolve this before thinking of immortality."
26594c6e-05b4-4cf5-a961-38e9a704b7ff/Eve.ru: - Конечно, знаю!<NL>Но не для того, чтобы стать Бессмертными — сначала мы должны раскрыть причину Искажения.<NL>Наши товарищи по секте страдают. Мы должны решить это, прежде чем думать о бессмертии".

26594c6e-05b4-4cf5-a961-38e9a704b7ff/Opt.ru: Неужели бессмертие для вас не имеет значения?

f9a53d5d-9d7b-418f-8678-fc842937ceb9/Eve.en: "Of course I do!<NL>The immortals in the pavilion know all things. They must know the cause of the Deviation.<NL>If I'm fortunate enough to attain immortality, I can save our sectmates myself."
f9a53d5d-9d7b-418f-8678-fc842937ceb9/Eve.ru: - Конечно, знаю!<NL>Бессмертные в павильоне знают все. Они должны знать причину Искажения.<NL>Если мне посчастливится достичь бессмертия, я сам смогу спасти наших товарищей по секте."

af972138-238b-47cf-a7a6-7f4e280f47e6/Eve.en: <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> nods, then shakes <Character key=RanshanFootman str=GenderPossessive/> head,<NL><NL>"From rogue cultivators to the Qinglang Master, everyone in Ranshan dreams of immortality.<NL>But after the contest, I've seen enough—elders' duels, countless martial arts,<NL>and even Taiwu's teachings. I'm already satisfied, hehe!<NL>This trip to the Qinglang Pavilion, let's just focus on uncovering the cause of the Deviation. As for immortality...<NL>The mortal world is still beautiful. Why not ascend another day?"

47115725-3249-4833-b3a0-fcca4162c3d9/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> faintly recalls that <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> was once a small child before entering the Dream of Clouds.<NL>If all Ranshan disciples share this pure heart, understand the meaning behind "ascend another day,"<NL>why would they fight and bleed for an uncertain path?<NL>As the words fade, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> looks around and asks,<NL><NL>"Then, Seniors, and Successor of Taiwu... what about you?<NL>Will you go to Qinglang Pavilion?"

1b72f141-4ca0-4a5b-8baa-d03e4db6d85c/Eve.en: The question brings silence among the five. <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> senses something amiss.<NL><Character key=RanshanFootman str=GenderSubject /> glances at the troubled Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, and Ying Jiao,<NL>then looks back at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and asks,<NL><NL>"Then, Seniors, and Successor of Taiwu... what about you?<NL>Will you go to Qinglang Pavilion?"

355798f7-c3f5-4027-8520-7dfdef392db7/Eve.en: Gazing at the endless desert and the golden glow on the horizon,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> ponders all of Ranshan's happenings.<NL>Back then, when first arriving at the sect, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> learned of the Qinglang Pavilion from a Ranshan disciple.<NL><NL>Since then—the contests, the guidance from three companions—all seemed to lead this way.<NL>Everything has been too smooth, as if someone has been orchestrating <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> journey to the Qinglang Pavilion...

355798f7-c3f5-4027-8520-7dfdef392db7/Opt.en: (Could it be the Three School Founders...)

53b0a0ee-8153-4649-9bba-8333e6019268/Eve.en: And then, there was the accidental entry into Qinglang Pavilion, and the entrusted tokens.<NL>And the dream before the Tri-School Contest, where the founders extended a warm welcome. Such fate—how can it be mere chance?<NL>Looking at the struggling disciples, chasing after the golden light,<NL>a thought flashes through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind...

53b0a0ee-8153-4649-9bba-8333e6019268/Opt.en: To enter Qinglang Pavilion is fate—I should follow destiny and ascend...
53b0a0ee-8153-4649-9bba-8333e6019268/Opt.ru: Войти в павильон Цинлан — это судьба, я должен последовать за судьбой и вознестись...

53b0a0ee-8153-4649-9bba-8333e6019268/Opt.en: To enter Qinglang Pavilion is a trap—someone uses "fate" to lure me in...
53b0a0ee-8153-4649-9bba-8333e6019268/Opt.ru: Вход в павильон Цинлан — это ловушка: кто-то использует "судьбу", чтобы заманить меня внутрь...

760f0186-cb56-4e84-bfc1-c4b5017cf961/Eve.en: And then, there was the accidental entry into Qinglang Pavilion, and the entrusted tokens.<NL>And the dream before the Tri-School Contest, where the founders extended a warm welcome. Such fate—how can it be mere chance?<NL>Looking at the struggling disciples, chasing after the golden light,<NL>a thought flashes through <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind...

2838a61a-28a2-4564-b29b-cd023b51cae4/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finishes the thought—and then a loud voice echoes from the sky,<NL>shaking the desert like a bell through mountains,<NL><NL>"Well said, young one! Hahaha!"
2838a61a-28a2-4564-b29b-cd023b51cae4/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> заканчивает мысль — и тут с неба раздается громкий голос,<NL>сотрясая пустыню, как колокол в горах,<NL><NL>- Хорошо сказано, юноша! Ха-ха-ха!"

7beb695f-8699-4843-84fb-ebba1810c4c3/Eve.en: At these words, the Ranshan disciples prostrate themselves.<NL>In an instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> feels the ground tremble, forcing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> knees.<NL>In the distance, the desert splits, sand flows, and three massive stone pillars rise from the ground beneath the Qinglang Pavilion.<NL>They stretch to the heavens, blocking the sun, their surfaces shedding fragments as they ascend.

5852e8a8-8739-4cef-8df1-4a4ee17fbc2a/Eve.en: When the pillars finally stop rising, their surfaces reveal intricate carvings.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks up to see the colossal statues of the Three School Founders standing before the Qinglang Pavilion, each a hundred zhang tall.<NL>Their crowns pierce the clouds, and the Qinglang Pavilion serves as their halo, a divine and awe-inspiring sight.<NL>The booming voice continues,<NL><NL>"This Tri-School Contest shows great promise from all..."

5fbf1176-5f30-45cb-92a3-217afbdfe735/Eve.en: "Senior, our Ranshan Sect is stronger than ever!"<NL><NL>With another rumble, the three statues open their eyes, their crescent-like brows revealing kind smiles.<NL>They look down like benevolent elders watching over their children.

3208910b-8291-490b-a630-920752502960/Eve.en: "Many possess the talent for immortality! This time, let us take in a few more disciples into Qinglang Pavilion!"<NL><NL>The three colossal statues finish their declaration and each spreads its arms.<NL>The desert sand begins to swirl, gathering into their hands without a breeze, forming scrolls.<NL>The writing on them seems closely tied to Qinglang Pavilion.

ee3989a1-2759-4dfa-82e7-641c02c9666e/Eve.en: At this moment, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, like the distant Ranshan disciples,<NL>holds <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> breath, gazes upward, and intently watches the back of the dust scrolls, listening to the voices of the statues,<NL><NL>"Those whose names are called, step forward..."<NL><NL>"Jade Seal School, Hua Ju..."<NL>"Divine Sword School, Xuan Zhi..."<NL>"Yin Yang School, Ying Jiao..."<NL><NL>The first ones chosen are the 'Top of the Three Schools'.<NL>Given their acclaim in the recent contest, their selection comes as no surprise.

22863ee7-3401-489e-b8b3-cc98eabef720/Eve.en: Hearing their names, Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, and Ying Jiao silently glance at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, then step forward.<NL>The statues continue reading names aloud, and excited cheers ripple from the disciples in the distance.<NL><NL>"Jade Seal School, Hua Heng..."<NL>"Divine Sword School, Hua Fu..."<NL>"Jade Seal School, Zhong Yan..."<NL>"Yin Yang School, Hua Xia..."

28394519-ce78-4d88-b34a-8b414957afb6/Eve.en: "Those called, the doors of the Qinglang Pavilion are now open to you...<NL>To the others, do not lose heart. You are all rising stars, only lacking in immortal fate."<NL><NL>Suddenly, the reading halts.<NL>The statues press their palms together, and the scrolls in their hands crumble into dust with a thunderous sound.<NL>From the distant crowd comes a chorus of sighs.

7a8ef8ae-2e7d-4d77-8977-2c93d3b32af1/Eve.en: "Yet, there is still one more. Though not a contestant, this person plays a pivotal role in its outcome.<NL>Ranshan invites this one into Qinglang Pavilion, to partake in the rite of ascension!<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />!"

ab227699-d9df-4777-a1a3-4b407d39c158/Eve.en: At these words, the crowd erupts in murmurs,<NL>some lamenting their own inadequacy, others voicing agreement, and still others questioning the inclusion of an outsider.<NL>Meanwhile, Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, and Ying Jiao silently look at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, their eyes shimmering with unspoken thoughts.<NL>Then, the ground shakes once more, and one of the statues makes a sword gesture.<NL>The sand beneath <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s feet solidifies into a hundred-chi-long stone sword stele,<NL>carrying <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> toward the Qinglang Pavilion in the distance.

bd3cfdb3-42a2-4a60-b35d-07365717a45c/Eve.en: Moments later, several more stone sword steles rise into the air,<NL>carrying the other chosen ones, following closely behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...<NL>Looking down at the disciples who were not chosen, seeing the envy and jealousy in their eyes,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> feels an unbridgeable gap has formed between them.

87ab187c-0e4b-4086-8339-fb14f26134bf/Eve.en: Before their eyes are jade towers and auspicious auras; in their ears, solemn immortal music echoes...<NL>After a brief sensation of weightlessness, the world fades, the winds shift,<NL>and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finally arrives in the Qinglang Pavilion.

1439247d-6070-4ff2-b428-71287ab38559/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finishes the thought—and then a loud voice echoes from the sky,<NL>shaking the desert like a bell through mountains,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, how dare you!"
1439247d-6070-4ff2-b428-71287ab38559/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> заканчивает мысль — и тут с неба раздается громкий голос,<NL>сотрясая пустыню, как колокол в горах,<NL><NL>"Преемник Тайу, как ты смеешь!"

fba25d9a-6aab-41d8-b0e8-ae32b535dc46/Eve.en: At these words, the Ranshan disciples prostrate themselves.<NL>In an instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> feels the ground tremble, making it hard to stand, and nearly falls to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> knees.<NL>In the distance, the desert splits, sand flows, and three massive stone pillars rise from the ground beneath the Qinglang Pavilion.<NL>They stretch to the heavens, blocking the sun, their surfaces shedding fragments as they ascend.

bbbefe05-681b-4d22-b0c5-b81dd8ed0b21/Eve.en: When the pillars finally stop rising, their surfaces reveal intricate carvings.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looks up to see the colossal statues of the Three School Founders standing before the Qinglang Pavilion, each a hundred zhang tall.<NL>Their crowns pierce the clouds, and the Qinglang Pavilion serves as their halo, a divine and awe-inspiring sight.<NL>The booming voice continues,<NL><NL>"How dare an ant like you defy the might of the immortals!?"

bbbefe05-681b-4d22-b0c5-b81dd8ed0b21/Opt.en: Hiding behind stone statues—what kind of immortal might is that?
bbbefe05-681b-4d22-b0c5-b81dd8ed0b21/Opt.ru: Прятаться за каменными статуями — что это за Бессмертная мощь такая?

b8168705-8392-4f4f-ac19-2fb4276aeec3/Eve.en: "To defy nature rules is to court destruction!"<NL><NL>With a series of rumbling roars, the three statues open their eyes, glaring down at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> on the sand.<NL>Their gaze is condescending, as if looking at a mere insect.

78c966f3-d9d7-46d4-aa24-6f8f64cde139/Eve.en: "Stubborn fool, be slain!"<NL><NL>As these words are spoken, one of the statues twists its wrist, curling its fingers into a sword gesture.<NL>The desert sand gathers in the air without wind, forming hundred-chi-long stone sword steles.<NL>Then, the sword tips turn, stirring a mighty gale, all pointing toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

9f59748f-f237-4adf-93c6-b331f4666d1f/Eve.en: Disciples cry out in panic, shielding their heads.<NL><NL>Yet Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, and Ying Jiao remain calm,<NL>as if they had already anticipated that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> would uncover the plots of the Three School Founders.<NL>Hua Ju asks in a deep voice,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, what should we do now?"

22f6abf8-9dc5-4ad6-92db-76529a691b67/Eve.en: As the stone sword steles take shape, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s thoughts grow clearer.<NL>This realm is a dream created by the founders. No escape, no refuge.<NL>Only one place remains where the founders cannot hide behind statues or shroud themselves in clouds...<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> must drag them out there and uncover the truth.

41f1f81f-a36f-499d-b088-4608d1c3aaab/Eve.en: With that, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> immediately activates <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> lightness skill, dashing toward the Qinglang Pavilion.<NL>The three statues give <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> no pause. A booming shout follows,<NL><NL>"Sword reaches truth, transformation is boundless!"<NL><NL>A sword stele crashes into the sand ahead of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, sending a rain of sand into the air,<NL>becoming the first obstacle on <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s path.

fa3fb1f6-75c9-4dcf-a6b9-9df24845e6e0/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> seizes the opportunity to step onto the sword stele,<NL>takes a deep breath, and in a few steps runs from the blade to the hilt,<NL>then leaps high, charging toward another oncoming sword stele.<NL>Wind slashes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s face like knives.<NL>But Qinglang Pavilion, once distant, now feels within reach...

d55c2fe8-78bc-47f4-bb6f-3c7ddf7378c0/Eve.en: Step by step,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> activates <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> Footwork Arts to dodge the incoming blades,<NL>using them for leverage, gliding with agility through the sword storm, drawing ever closer to the pavilion.<NL>But at the same time, one of the statues points two fingers at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and booms,<NL><NL>"Vast chaos, spirit floods the land!"<NL><NL>Before the words fade, the sand in the air transforms into raging torrents, riding on primal spiritual Qi, surging toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

03b76aed-3887-4e45-98fd-fb4e03ff3ac5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> takes another deep breath, wields the Fuyu Hilt, and strikes forcefully.<NL>Miraculously, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> blocks the oncoming sword stele, halting it before the primal, spiritual Qi.<NL><NL>With a loud crash, the sword stele is shattered into dust by the immense force...<NL>But <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> leaps out of the dust, continuing to sprint toward the Qinglang Pavilion, stepping on the sword steles.

dd3e4657-3dd2-4e27-951b-c9721d8b5fae/Eve.en: A thousand zhang, a hundred, ten...<NL>The closer <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gets to the Qinglang Pavilion, the dimmer its light becomes, and the more illusory the palace within appears.<NL>The final statue, seeing this, opens its mouth and spews out endless sand, forming layers of curtains before the Qinglang Pavilion,<NL><NL>"Mantra of Separation, join the void!"<NL><NL>Facing the layers of blockade, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> intends to gather <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> strength and break through...<NL>But the sand enters <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> nose and mouth, causing an itchy, choking sensation that leads to uncontrollable coughing.

dbcd3fea-ba7e-4131-ba48-d38069e3c3cc/Eve.en: At this critical moment,<NL>the curtains of sand suddenly explode, turning into scattered grains, and the path to the Qinglang Pavilion is cleared.<NL>Behind the curtains, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sees the figure of an old man, emaciated and hollow-eyed,<NL>as if time has left indelible scars on his body and soul.<NL>He floats among the dust, raises his right hand, and points toward the Qinglang Pavilion,<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, I leave it to you..."

2bfead4d-0c15-457d-8076-887ba53544a1/Eve.en: Watching the palace twist like a reflection in water...<NL>Hearing the statues behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/> crumble with a thunderous roar...<NL>After a brief sensation of weightlessness, the world fades, the winds shift,<NL>and at last, Qinglang Pavilion unveils its true face before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

f030e048-eb23-4eb1-b1d7-7674b266a7cb/Eve.en: "What do I think? Too many people, haha!<NL>In past Tri-School Contests, there were always disciples who couldn't attend for various reasons.<NL>Some were delayed on the road, unable to return in time; others felt their skills were inadequate and chose to abstain.<NL>Ranshan disciples are free-spirited—if they don't want to come, I never force them."

a96246bf-9835-44d1-98df-e90dfc1ac499/Eve.en: "But this time,<NL>word's gotten around that 'the Successor of Taiwu has the founders' tokens,' and 'the founders' messenger has come down,'<NL>disciples are flocking to the mountain, eager for the event."

63b279e9-da8e-4393-99cf-ca884768b4be/Eve.en: "Now, apprentices bombard their masters, asking what the Successor of Taiwu looks like...<NL>And masters? They're shoving all their students into the competition.<NL><NL>It takes me four hours just to verify the name lists,<NL>let alone remember who they are or where they trained..."

0c4f6ede-e0f1-481e-94a3-6e5904b9d3c4/Eve.en: "In the end, only three stood out to me.<NL>They're unfamiliar faces, but they grasped our Ranshan martial arts deeply. They wielded our arts with true mastery.<NL>Perhaps they encountered great fortune during their travels..."

7b00a67f-6223-4623-89be-b71bfdb291d4/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> walks with <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> across the Taiji lawn,<NL>watching the vivid scenes of seals appearing and flying swords dancing,<NL>listening to the cheers and debates that rise and fall around them.<NL>The child, holding a branch, runs around excitedly,<NL><NL>"Master says once I'm older, I can travel with seniors.<NL>With experience, my martial arts will improve too..."

ea449484-ce07-4ddb-bea9-a8e3591dd6a8/Eve.en: As they speak, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> picks a match and eagerly squeezes into the crowd.<NL>A sigh suddenly rises from the crowd:<NL><NL>"Sigh..."
ea449484-ce07-4ddb-bea9-a8e3591dd6a8/Eve.ru: Пока они говорят, <Character key=RanshanFootman str=Name /> чиркает спичкой и нетерпеливо протискивается в толпу.<NL>Внезапно в толпе раздается вздох:<NL><NL>"Вздох..."

f2aa409b-4f73-477c-9499-7e2be0303688/Eve.en: When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> squeezes through the crowd and rushes to the scene,<NL>two disciples of Ranshan are already trading blows with their weapons.<NL>One of them grins playfully, shouting nonsense with every move,<NL><NL>"Watch out, danger on your left!"<NL>"You see it on the left, now it's on the right!"<NL>"Your footing is weak, your back wide open!"

6bcad223-fcd3-4fa8-85b7-9c3a1d06e055/Eve.en: The other disciple flails their arms and stomps in fury,<NL><NL>"Shut up! Stop yelling! This is absurd! Who spars like this?!"<NL><NL>As they fight and shout, their strikes hold no more force, but their voices grow ever louder,<NL>spittle flies, and the crowd erupts in boos.

98b186a9-4333-49be-84cf-59d8917c21d9/Eve.en: In no time, <Character key=CharA str=Name /> throws <Character key=CharB str=Name /> into confusion,<NL>seizing the moment to launch a sudden strike and lands a hit, declaring triumphantly that <Character key=CharA str=GenderPossessive /> opponent falls to the art of the "Sword of Words."<NL>The immortal master watching from the side shakes his head with a wry smile, wondering whether this "Sword of Words" counts as a martial art.<NL>Meanwhile, the two disciples exchange glances and turn their attention to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

98b186a9-4333-49be-84cf-59d8917c21d9/Opt.en: When masters clash, nothing is off-limits—"Sword of Words" must be a form of martial arts...
98b186a9-4333-49be-84cf-59d8917c21d9/Opt.ru: Когда мастера сталкиваются, нет ничего запретного - "Меч слов" должен быть формой Боевых искусств...

98b186a9-4333-49be-84cf-59d8917c21d9/Opt.en: No technique, no form, just random shouting—how could this compare to true martial arts...
98b186a9-4333-49be-84cf-59d8917c21d9/Opt.ru: Никакой техники, никакой формы, просто случайные выкрики — разве это может сравниться с настоящими Боевыми искусствами?..

a4d7f01e-ca1f-49cf-831b-0686c9567c03/Eve.en: "Well said!"<NL>"As expected of the Successor of Taiwu, nothing is off-limits..."<NL>"If this 'Sword of Words' works so well, I might try it when it's my turn!"<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> speaks, the surrounding disciples nod in agreement, and the immortal master promptly declares the winner.<NL><Character key=CharA str=Name /> secures a victory, overjoyed, and bows gratefully to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

a7ff6006-8111-47e7-8430-377d0b535a79/Eve.en: "Well said, well said..."<NL>"Petty tricks, unorthodox methods—nothing worth mentioning..."<NL>"With a focused mind and calm spirit, no amount of shouting will matter..."<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> speaks, the surrounding disciples nod in agreement, and the immortal master promptly declares the winner.<NL><Character key=CharB str=Name /> secures a victory, overjoyed, and bows gratefully to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

aecaa8e4-6d2a-4971-a1f2-fe1853df0de8/Eve.en: The vast Taiji lawn is bustling with activity, lively and crowded.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> notices that when the disciples debate, they constantly quote ancient texts—words of sages and wise men come one after another.<NL>It seems that uttering these classical phrases gives their arguments extra weight.<NL>The child shares this sentiment, standing on tiptoe and whispering,<NL><NL>"I'll tell you a secret—some of my seniors often mimic our masters and uncles, spouting grand philosophies.<NL>When they can't win an argument, they act all profound and use the founders' words to shut people down... hehe!"

36137a7b-3174-4e33-9d3b-831802f00455/Eve.en: As soon as the child finishes speaking, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> spots another crowd and leans in to listen,<NL>but soon frowns, scratching their head, and waves repeatedly to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL><NL>"Taiwu, come quick! They're talking way over my head..."

63ce0dcf-5f94-44a7-9cf6-0da6222d9066/Eve.en: When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pushes through the crowd and arrives at the scene,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> sees two disciples sitting on meditation cushions, swaying their heads,<NL>seemingly debating the situation in Shandong. One disciple sighs,<NL><NL>"The sages say, 'Knowing contentment avoids disgrace, knowing when to stop avoids danger'...<NL>We are but mortal flesh—making it safely through the Blackstone Land is already fortune enough...<NL>How can we hope to reclaim Mt. Tai and Ji River from the demons?"

8543e7de-0b06-455f-8d3a-2a7473ad6270/Eve.en: Hearing this, the other disciple frowns and responds loudly,<NL><NL>"My friend, you're mistaken!<NL>The sages say, 'Put yourself last, and you lead; forget yourself, and you endure.'<NL>We are no reckless fools, but we understand the principle of shared fate.<NL>If no one is willing to risk their life, to achieve selflessness through self-interest, the world is doomed!"

92f4565b-c6f5-4feb-a07a-a6d45c385065/Eve.en: With that, the two find no agreement and sigh in turn.<NL>The immortal masters nearby shakes their head, noting that whenever the topic of demonic chaos arises, the debate stalls.<NL>Seeing the surrounding disciples murmuring, the two disciples exchange glances and look toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

92f4565b-c6f5-4feb-a07a-a6d45c385065/Opt.en: Blackstone Land is overrun with demons—it's wise to prioritize self-preservation...
92f4565b-c6f5-4feb-a07a-a6d45c385065/Opt.ru: Земля Блэкстоуна кишит демонами — разумно ставить во главу угла самосохранение...

92f4565b-c6f5-4feb-a07a-a6d45c385065/Opt.en: Failing to recognize impending disaster is no different than inviting death...
92f4565b-c6f5-4feb-a07a-a6d45c385065/Opt.ru: Неспособность распознать надвигающуюся катастрофу ничем не отличается от того, чтобы навлечь на себя смерть...

16fae11a-7ec0-4a3d-aac9-90929cecc103/Eve.en: "This makes sense..."<NL>"I, too, wish to reclaim the Ji River and Mt. Tai..."<NL>"Such a great task is beyond mortals—it should be left to the immortals..."<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> spoke, the surrounding nodded in agreement, and the Immortal Master promptly declared the winner.<NL>Having secured a victory, <Character key=CharA str=Name /> was overjoyed and bowed gratefully to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.

f9771c58-7413-46b3-912c-b759ccac386e/Eve.en: "This makes sense!"<NL>"The Ji River borders Qingzhou—the people of Qingzhou must come first..."<NL>"Isn't the Successor of Taiwu exactly the kind who risks the life without hesitation?"<NL><NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> spoke, the surrounding nodded in agreement, and the Immortal Master promptly declared the winner.<NL>Having secured a victory, <Character key=CharB str=Name /> was overjoyed and bowed gratefully to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.
